analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 34.8 entering oversold territory, with 5-day and 20-day lows at $631.24 confirming a Higher Low pattern. However, MACD histogram continues to worsen at -3.7340, and ADX at 27.1 indicates a clear trend but with -DI significantly higher than +DI, showing downward pressure dominance. Low volume (0.38x) reduces confidence in trend reversal. Aligns with overall market risk management (QQQ -3.7% drop). Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
